description: Ranks two or more companies by the gap between price and owner-earnings value, from their SEC filings, with the loss-makers and the unvaluable named rather than dropped. Same engine as compare_valuations. Example questions: "Which is cheaper, Coke or Pepsi?"; "Rank AAPL, MSFT and GOOGL on value"; "Which of my stocks is most overvalued?"

companies.description: Ticker and current share price for each company

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B

name: which_stock_is_cheapest
title: Which Stock Is Cheapest
